landmarks.name: clypeal_margin_ant_mid
landmarks.note: Anteriormost midline point of the head part. GLAD HL anterior endpoint. Verify it sits on the median clypeal margin, not on a mandible or the labrum.

landmarks.name: cephalic_margin_post_mid
landmarks.note: Posteriormost midline point of the head part. GLAD HL posterior endpoint. Verify it is the occipital margin midpoint, not inside the neck/foramen.

landmarks.name: mandibular_apex_r
landmarks.note: Vertex furthest from the mandibular articulation = the apical tooth. HIGHEST-RISK point: the template is a mean mandible, and correspondence on trap-jaw (Odontomachus) and long-mandible (Aenictus) forms may not hold.

landmarks.name: antennal_insertion_r
landmarks.note: Head vertex nearest the scape articulation. Torular/antennal insertion.

landmarks.name: scape_apex_r
landmarks.note: Furthest scape vertex from its articulation. NOTE: GLAD SL excludes the basal condyle/neck, so the proximal endpoint is the articulation, not the bulb.

landmarks.name: wl_anterior_r
landmarks.note: Anteriormost mesosoma vertex in the right lateral band -- the front of the pronotum in profile, excluding the neck. Type III constructed.

landmarks.name: wl_posterior_r
landmarks.note: Posteroventral-most mesosoma vertex in the same lateral band -- the posterior basal angle of the metapleuron, behind and below the hind coxa. Type III.

landmarks.name: petiole_ant_mid
landmarks.note: Anterior petiole, VENTRAL midline outline (same-surface rule).

landmarks.name: gaster_apex_mid
landmarks.note: Posteriormost midline gaster point (TBL endpoint). Taken over b_a_3+b_a_4 because b_a_5 carries no vertices.

head_region.rule: max |y| extent within head part -> HW
head_region.note: Whole head part. HW is a max, not a percentile.

pronotum_region.rule: anterior third of mesosoma by x -> PW
pronotum_region.note: PLACEHOLDER. The pronotum is not a modelled part; this is the anterior third of b_t by x and needs hand-painting in Blender.

eye_region_r.rule: max diameter within eye region -> EL
eye_region_r.note: No eye geometry is separable from the head part. EL and HW2 cannot be computed until an eye vertex group is painted, or they are dropped.

mirror_map_note: template is exactly mirror-symmetric; left-side indices derived, never clicked
